recipe.title: Three Minute Tomato Sauce
recipe.description: A quick and easy tomato sauce that can be adapted with various ingredients for a flavorful dish.
ingredients: tomatoes, cleaned and crushed by hand
instructions: Put a pan on full heat.
Add garlic and chilli to the pan.
Add chopped basil stalks to the pan.
Add crushed tomatoes to the pan.
Add fresh pasta sheets (lasagna sheets) to the seasoned water.
Drain the pasta in a colander, but do not steam it. Instead, feed it just a little bit of the starchy water.
Cook the pasta for 30 seconds in the sauce.
Season to taste with extra virgin olive oil and feta cheese.
Serve on a platter with small basil leaves and a kiss of extra virgin olive oil.
recipe.notes: This recipe can be adapted with various ingredients for a flavorful dish. The pasta sheets are fresh and available in supermarkets, making it easy to use any pasta you prefer.
